reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate OpenRouter
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new OpenRouter API key.

data_description.model: Pick a router (Auto, Auto beta, Jev, or any author/auto slug) to let OpenRouter choose the model per request, or pick a fixed model.
data_description.cost_tier: Router cost policy. Leave empty to use the router's default. Ignored for fixed models.
data_description.allowed_models: Model slugs or wildcard patterns such as anthropic/*. Auto Router treats this as a hard limit; Jev treats it as a preference and falls back to the full pool if nothing it matches is routable. Ignored for fixed models.
data_description.excluded_models: Model slugs or patterns the router must never pick. Always enforced. Ignored for fixed models.
data_description.web_search: Let the model search the web through OpenRouter when it needs current information. Searches are billed by OpenRouter.

init.title: OpenRouter text-to-speech
init.description: Choose a speech model. Its voices are listed on the next page.

data_description.model: Speech model to synthesize with. Pick from the list or enter any OpenRouter TTS model slug.

data_description.voice: Pick one of the model's voices, or type a provider-specific voice ID. Can be overridden per call with the voice option.
data_description.instructions: Tone, pacing or emotion, such as "Speak in a warm and friendly tone." Only some models (OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, Gemini, Fish Audio) use it; Gemini requires it.
data_description.response_format: Leave empty for the model's default. Some models only return one format and reject the other.
data_description.speed: Playback speed multiplier. Only some models support it; others may reject a non-default value.

confirm.title: Replace expiring OpenRouter API key
confirm.description: The OpenRouter API key {label} expires on {expires_at}, and keys can't be extended. Create a new key at {keys_url}, then submit to start reauthentication and enter it.

budget_exhausted.title: OpenRouter API key {label} is out of budget
budget_exhausted.description: Requests are failing because the OpenRouter API key {label} has spent its budget. Raise the limit on OpenRouter or wait for it to reset.
